Establish the self-referential identity of the critical point at x=0, marking the singularity.
Split the evaluation into two independent arms for the variables x and y.
Evaluate the logarithmic term ln x on the T-arm, representing the accepting pole.
Affirm the concave nature of the logarithmic term, establishing the T-state for this arm.
Evaluate the exponential term e^y on the F-arm, representing the donating pole with sign reversal.
Affirm the convex nature of the exponential term, establishing the F-state for this arm.
Rejoin the arms at the saddle point, fusing the concave and convex behaviors into the B-state.
Hold the asymmetric chiral landscape live, maintaining the contradiction between the two poles.
Compose the fused result into the final scalar field S(x,y).
Record the smooth, non-topological scalar field as a permanent, irreversible measurement.
Anchor the system in the separable sum structure, closing the boundary of the generic network.
